parts.html: The K-07 kitchen model offers a refined contemporary design built around a bright white color palette, practical cabinet storage, and an efficient U-shaped layout.
Its defining feature is the three-sided arrangement of kitchen cabinetry, creating an organized cooking environment with extensive work surfaces and convenient access to everyday essentials.
The U-shaped configuration allows the main kitchen functions to be distributed across different areas, providing dedicated space for food preparation, washing, built-in appliances, and storage.
Painted white cabinet fronts create a clean architectural appearance, making the kitchen suitable for contemporary apartments, open-plan interiors, and private residences.
The solid-color finish complements natural wood, decorative stone, neutral wall colors, and a wide range of modern interior materials.
A porcelain stoneware countertop introduces a distinctive material texture while providing a practical surface for everyday food preparation.

With a total linear length of 6.9 meters, the K-07 kitchen offers extensive cabinetry without requiring a separate kitchen island. This arrangement preserves open circulation space in the center of the room.
The upper and lower cabinets feature painted fronts, while the main cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard.
A pull-out cargo system helps organize kitchen essentials and make efficient use of the available storage space.
For comfortable everyday operation, the model includes Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges and Atira Hettich drawer systems. Cabinet handles are included in the configuration.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for residential properties in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-07 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, architectural features, appliance requirements, and storage preferences.
Our services include personalized kitchen planning, material selection, cabinet manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
Additional equipment, including kitchen sinks, built-in appliances, extractor hoods, and plumbing fixtures, can be selected according to the client's requirements.
Order your K-07 kitchen from DUMSKAYA DESIGN and create a bright contemporary interior with an efficient three-sided kitchen layout.
